prior_research_gap: Local control-plan metadata inspected; inaccessible prior studies and protected transcripts not retrieved or reused. No empirical tactic-frequency estimate is asserted.
source_note: Rule text reproduced by Cornell LII; official current rules index: https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/current-rules-practice-procedure/federal-rules-evidence

tactics.name: Short leading-question sequence
tactics.explanation: A series of narrow leading questions seeks discrete admissions.
tactics.purpose: Test one proposition at a time.
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Leading form does not require agreement.
Yes momentum is not a formal evidence doctrine.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Assess each premise independently; qualify or correct inaccuracies.

tactics.name: Commitment followed by contradiction
tactics.explanation: A clear present account is contrasted with conflicting evidence.
recognition_cues: Present version fixed before document comparison
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Do not manufacture conflict by stripping context.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Keep the account accurate and explain a real distinction if one exists.

tactics.name: Prior inconsistent statement
tactics.explanation: A prior statement is compared with current testimony.
recognition_cues: Earlier words contrasted with present account
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: FRE 613(b) generally requires an opportunity to explain/deny before extrinsic evidence, unless court orders otherwise; opposing-party statements are excepted.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Read or listen carefully; acknowledge an accurate prior statement and truthfully explain any difference.

tactics.name: Omission-based impeachment
tactics.explanation: An earlier account lacks a detail now supplied.
recognition_cues: Why was this not mentioned earlier?
required_conditions: Earlier account context makes omission probative
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Silence alone is not contradiction or lying.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Explain the earlier account’s scope honestly; do not invent an excuse.

tactics.name: Compound or false-premise question
tactics.explanation: A question joins propositions or assumes an unsupported premise.
recognition_cues: An assumption embedded in the question
required_conditions: Question actually contains ambiguity or unsupported premise
tactics.source_scope: Richmond outline pp. 5, 11; FRE 611 court control
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Question-form objections depend on applicable rules and rulings.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Ask to separate or clarify; correct a false premise without guessing.

tactics.name: Invitation to speculate
tactics.explanation: A question asks beyond the witness’s perception or permitted expertise.
recognition_cues: Questions about unseen events or another person’s thoughts
required_conditions: No adequate personal-knowledge foundation or approved expert basis
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Expert testimony has distinct rules; do not apply lay limits mechanically.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Distinguish what you perceived from inference and what you do not know.

tactics.name: Selective statement and completeness
tactics.explanation: A selected passage may omit context needed to avoid misimpression.
tactics.confidence_basis: Public source support for technique description; no case-specific prediction or efficacy estimate.
limits: Current FRE 106 covers statements, including unrecorded oral statements.
Completion is not automatic admission of every related passage.
Jurisdiction, competition rules and rulings control.
truthful_handling: Identify the missing qualification accurately; counsel handles a completeness request.
